title: fegp109
subject: Mathematics
summary: SYMMETRY 9 Look around you — you may find many objects that catch your attention. Some such things are shown below: Butterfly Flower Pinwheel Rangoli There is something beautiful about the pictures above. The flower looks the same from many different angles. No doubt, the colours are very attractive. But what else about the butterfly appeals to you? In these pictures, it appears that some parts of the figure are repeated and these repetitions seem to occur in a definite pattern. Can you see what repeats in the beautiful rangoli figure? Ganita Prakash | Grade 6 218 rangoli, the red petals come back onto themselves when the flower is rotated by 90˚ around the centre and so do the other parts of the rangoli. Can you spot which pattern is repeating? Now, can you say what figure repeats along each side of the hexagon?
